summary: Forensic analysis of 332 Go files (~112K lines) in td CLI. Found 1 fully orphaned package (internal/crypto, 335 lines), 19 dead exported functions never called outside their defining file, 1 deprecated function, multiple test-only exports that could be unexported, and a documentation-only data structure. No stubs, no commented-out code blocks, no unused go.mod dependencies. The codebase is remarkably clean for its size. Total estimated removable dead code: ~491 lines.

dead_code.name: internal/crypto (entire package)
dead_code.evidence: Zero imports from any other package in the codebase. grep -rn '"github.com/marcus/td/internal/crypto"' returns nothing. Package provides E2E encryption primitives (X25519, AES-256-GCM, ECDH+HKDF, Argon2id) that were likely planned for td-sync but never integrated.

dead_code.name: FormatSessionID
dead_code.evidence: No callers outside internal/session package (including tests). Formats session ID with optional name lookup.

dead_code.name: GetWithContextCheck
dead_code.evidence: No callers outside internal/session package (including tests). Appears to be an unused wrapper around session Get with context checking.

dead_code.name: GetAllTransitions
dead_code.evidence: No callers outside internal/workflow package (including tests). Returns all registered state transitions.

dead_code.name: SetMode
dead_code.evidence: No callers outside internal/workflow package (including tests). Sets transition mode on StateMachine.

dead_code.name: GetTransitionsFrom
dead_code.evidence: No callers outside internal/workflow package (including tests). Returns valid target statuses from a given status.

dead_code.name: GetTransitionsTo
dead_code.evidence: No callers outside internal/workflow package (including tests). Returns valid source statuses for a given target.

dead_code.name: JSONErrorWithDetails
dead_code.evidence: No callers outside internal/output package (including tests). Outputs an error as JSON with additional context.

dead_code.name: CanViewProject
dead_code.evidence: No callers outside internal/serverdb package, not even in tests. API uses Authorize() directly with role string instead. Unlike CanPush/CanPull/etc which at least have test callers, CanViewProject is never called anywhere.

dead_code.name: ConfigDir
dead_code.evidence: No callers outside internal/syncconfig package (including tests). Returns sync config directory path. Internal functions use it within the package.

dead_code.name: GenerateDeviceID
dead_code.evidence: No callers outside internal/syncconfig package (including tests). Called internally by GetDeviceID(). Should be unexported.

dead_code.name: LogCommandUsageAsync
dead_code.evidence: No callers anywhere (not even tests). The synchronous version LogCommandUsage() is used instead in cmd/root.go:123.

dead_code.name: ReadCommandUsage
dead_code.evidence: No callers outside internal/db (including tests). The filtered version ReadCommandUsageFiltered() is used by cmd/stats_analytics.go instead.

dead_code.name: CountCommandUsage
dead_code.evidence: No callers outside internal/db (including tests). Counts command usage events but nothing reads this count.

dead_code.name: RecordAgentActivity
dead_code.evidence: No callers anywhere (not even tests). AssignIssue() in the same file directly inserts into agent_activity table with a different SQL pattern instead of calling this function.

dead_code.name: SearchIssues
dead_code.evidence: Only called by SearchIssuesRanked() within the same file. Should be unexported since it's only used as an internal helper.

dead_code.name: SetSchemaVersion
dead_code.evidence: No callers outside internal/db package (including tests). Schema version is set by RunMigrations() internally.

dead_code.name: UpdateSyncPulled
dead_code.evidence: No callers outside internal/db package (including tests). Autosync code updates sync state with direct SQL in transactions instead.

dead_code.name: UpdateSyncPushed
dead_code.evidence: No callers outside internal/db package (including tests). Autosync code updates sync state with direct SQL in transactions instead.

dead_code.name: ToSQLConditions
dead_code.evidence: No callers outside internal/query package (including tests). Appears to be an unfinished query optimization path.

dead_code.name: QuickSearch
dead_code.evidence: Only called in internal/query tests. Comment says 'backward compatible with existing search' but cmd/search.go uses db.SearchIssuesRanked() instead. Dead public API.

dead_code.name: RuntimeStats (over-exported)
dead_code.evidence: Only used within debug_stats.go. Exported type in cmd package that could be unexported. JSON tags work fine on unexported types with json.Encoder.

feature_flags.name: sync_cli
feature_flags.description: Gates sync/auth CLI commands. Default: false. Used by cmd/auth.go, cmd/sync.go, cmd/sync_conflicts.go, cmd/sync_init.go, cmd/project.go, cmd/config.go, cmd/doctor.go via AddFeatureGatedCommand().

feature_flags.name: sync_autosync
feature_flags.description: Gates startup/post-mutation/monitor autosync hooks. Default: false. Used in cmd/feature_gate.go (startup + mutation hooks) and cmd/monitor.go (periodic autosync loop).

feature_flags.name: sync_monitor_prompt
feature_flags.description: Gates first-run monitor sync setup prompt UX. Default: false. Used in pkg/monitor/commands.go:2042.

feature_flags.name: sync_notes
feature_flags.description: Gates notes entity sync. Default: true (only flag enabled by default). Used in cmd/sync.go:45 as syncEntityValidator.

deprecated.name: wrapModal
deprecated.description: Method on Model marked as deprecated in comment. Simply delegates to wrapModalWithDepth(). Zero callers found - all call sites already use wrapModalWithDepth() directly.

deprecated.name: SyncGateMap
deprecated.description: Documentation-only data structure mapping sync surfaces to feature flags. Contains stale reference to 'sunc' branch (typo for 'sync'). Only referenced in a single test (TestSyncGateMapReferencesKnownFeatures). 88 lines of static documentation that could be a markdown file instead.
deprecated.recommendation: document - convert to doc or remove

orphaned_files.description: E2E encryption primitives package (X25519, AES-256-GCM, ECDH+HKDF, Argon2id key derivation). Zero imports from anywhere in the codebase. Planned for td-sync encrypted sync but never integrated. Package also pulls in golang.org/x/crypto as a direct dependency.
Tests for orphaned crypto package. Will be removed when package is removed.
